answer: Funding-correlated escalating bond resists sybils: each identity posts a deposit, and when deposits trace to one common funding inlet the bond grows with each additional linked head — the k-th fake pays far more than the first, pushing a farm's total collateral super-linearly to a cost zenith. Independently-funded honest agents each meet only the flat floor. Precondition: shared deposit origin is detectable and per-head bond exceeds expected gain, so sybil capital-at-risk outruns any profit horizon.
